tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

messages.content:
## Input Language: zh Document: zh-0028, sentence 7 of 12 The previous sentences (at most five; number, tab, words): 2 而且 它 还 配备 了 D-Sub （ VGA ） ， HDMI 两 种 接口 ， 3 能够 在 拨接 电脑 设备 之 余 ， 还 能够 方便 用户 进行 PS3 、 Xbox360 、 蓝光机 等等 设备 的 连接 。 4 这 就 是 三星 B560 ， 你 值得 拥有 ! 5 方形 机身 和 方形 的 底座 设计 ， 笔挺 的 立姿 ， 有点 像 大师 打座 的 气势 。 6 它 有 三 个 接口 ， 分别 为 电源 、 HDMI 、 VGA 。 Their graphs: # ::snt 2 # sentence level graph: (s2a / and :op2 (s2p / 配备-01 :ARG2 (s2t / thing :refer-person 3rd :refer-number singular) :ARG1 (s2j / 接口 :quant 2 :mod (s2a2 / and :op1 (s2x / product :wiki - :name (s2n / name :op1 "D-Sub" :op2 "VGA")) :op2 (s2x2 / product :wiki "HDMI" :name (s2n2 / name :op1 "HDMI")))) :mod (s2h / 还) :aspect state)) I treated 配备 as `配备-01`, sense "equip". 它 ("it") fills `:ARG2`, the thing that gets equipped, and the interfaces fill `:ARG1`. PropBank's own example for this word is set up the same way: the satellite (这颗卫星上) is `ARG2` and the equipment is `ARG1`. A few choices could easily differ from the gold annotation: - **而且 ("moreover"):** I made it an `and` with only `:op2`, so the sentence links back to the previous one. Gold might instead put a `:mod` on `配备-01`. - **The two interfaces:** I wrote one `接口` node with `:quant 2` (the classifier 种 is dropped). The two named products hang under it through `:mod` and `and`. That `:mod` link is my own choice. Gold might use two separate `接口` nodes joined by `and`. - **D-Sub (VGA):** I made it a single name with two words, `"D-Sub"` and `"VGA"`, and gave it no wiki title (`-`). VGA could also be read as a second name for the same port, written in brackets. - **Aspect:** I gave `state`, because "it comes equipped with" describes a property of the device even though 了 is there. `performance` is the other possible reading. # ::snt 3 # sentence level graph: (s3a / and :op1 (s3b / 拨接-01 :ARG0 (s3t / thing :refer-person 3rd :refer-number singular) :ARG1 (s3s / 设备 :mod (s3d / 电脑)) :modal-strength neutral-affirmative :aspect habitual) :op2 (s3f / 方便-01 :ARG0 s3t :ARG1 (s3u / 用户) :ARG2 (s3l / 连接-01 :ARG0 s3u :ARG1 (s3s2 / 设备 :example (s3a2 / and :op1 (s3p / product :wiki "PlayStation_3" :name (s3n / name :op1 "PS3")) :op2 (s3p2 / product :wiki "Xbox_360" :name (s3n2 / name :op1 "Xbox360")) :op3 (s3g / 蓝光机)) :mod (s3e / 等等)) :aspect habitual) :mod (s3h / 还) :modal-strength neutral-affirmative :aspect habitual)) # ::snt 4 # sentence level graph: (s4a / and :op1 (s4i / identity-91 :ARG1 (s4t / thing :mod (s4z / 这)) :ARG2 (s4p / product :wiki - :name (s4n / name :op1 "三星" :op2 "B560")) :aspect state) :op2 (s4z2 / 值得-01 :ARG0 s4p :ARG1 (s4y / 拥有-01 :ARG0 (s4p2 / person :refer-person 2nd :refer-number singular) :ARG1 s4p :aspect state) :aspect state)) I treated the two clauses as `and`. The first, 这就是三星B560, is an identity: "this" is the Samsung B560. I left 就 out because it only adds emphasis. In the second, 你值得拥有, PropBank's 值得-01 has ARG0 as what makes something worthwhile, so the phone is its ARG0 and the owning (拥有-01) is its ARG1. "You" owns it (ARG0) and the phone, which the sentence doesn't repeat, is also what is owned (ARG1). A few calls are judgement rather than certain: - **Product name:** I made the phone a single `product` named "三星" "B560" and did not add Samsung as a separate company. - **Strength of 拥有:** Owning is only presented as worthwhile, not asserted. Its strength would be set under 值得 at the document level, so I didn't add a `:modal-strength` to it here. - **Joining the clauses:** The gold annotation might link them with something other than `and`, for example `multi-sentence`. # ::snt 5 # sentence level graph: (s5x / 像-01 :ARG0 (s5a / and :op1 (s5s / 设计-01 :ARG1 (s5a2 / and :op1 (s5j / 机身 :mod (s5f / 方形)) :op2 (s5d / 底座 :mod (s5f2 / 方形))) :aspect process) :op2 (s5l / 立姿 :mod (s5b / 笔挺))) :ARG1 (s5q / 气势 :mod (s5d2 / 打座-00 :ARG0 (s5m / 大师) :aspect process)) :degree (s5y / 有点) :aspect state) # ::snt 6 # sentence level graph: (s6a / and :op1 (s6y / 有-01 :ARG0 (s6t / thing :refer-person 3rd :refer-number singular) :ARG1 (s6j / 接口 :quant 3) :aspect state) :op2 (s6w / 为-01 :ARG0 s6j :ARG1 (s6a2 / and :op1 (s6d / 电源) :op2 (s6h / HDMI) :op3 (s6v / VGA)) :manner (s6f / 分别) :aspect state)) I based this on two PropBank lookups: - **有 (has):** I chose `有-01` (owner and thing owned). "它" (it) is the owner and is a third-person singular `thing`. The three ports are `接口 :quant 3`. The classifier 个 is left out. - **为 (are, namely):** I chose `为-01` (a thing and what it is said to be). Its `:ARG0` points back to the same ports node, and its `:ARG1` is an `and` of the three items: 电源 (power), HDMI and VGA. Some choices were judgement calls and could differ from the expert annotation: - **Joining the clauses:** there is no conjunction, so I linked them with a top-level `and`. Another option would be to attach the second clause to the ports with `:ARG0-of`. - **分别 (respectively):** I attached it to `为-01` as `:manner`. It could also be a plain `:mod`. - **Aspect:** both events are `state`, since one is owning and the other says what the ports are. This sentence: 7 高清 的 HDMI 接口 成为 现在 市场 的 主流 ， 很 有 可能 HDMI 就 是 2012 的 一 个 趋势 ， 同时 还 保留 有 VGA 的 接口 ， 让 消费者 在 不同 需求 上 得到 满足 。 Its graph: # ::snt 7 # sentence level graph: (s7a / and :op1 (s7c / 成为-01 :ARG0 (s7j / 接口 :mod (s7g / 高清) :mod (s7p / product :name (s7n / name :op1 "HDMI"))) :ARG1 (s7z / 主流 :mod (s7s / 市场 :temporal (s7x / 现在))) :aspect state) :op2 (s7i / identity-91 :ARG1 s7p :ARG2 (s7q / 趋势 :temporal (s7d / date-entity :year 2012)) :aspect state :modal-strength partial-affirmative) :op3 (s7b / 保留-01 :ARG0 s7p :ARG1 (s7j2 / 接口 :mod (s7p2 / product :name (s7n2 / name :op1 "VGA"))) :mod (s7h / 还) :temporal (s7t / 同时) :purpose (s7r / 让-02 :ARG1 (s7k / 消费者) :ARG2 (s7e / 得到-01 :ARG0 s7k :ARG1 (s7m / 满足-01 :ARG2 (s7x2 / 需求-01 :ARG0 s7k :mod (s7y / 不同) :aspect state) :aspect process) :aspect activity) :aspect activity) :aspect state))
I think 很有可能 ("very likely") counts as probable, not merely possible. So the `identity-91` (HDMI 就是 2012 的趋势) gets `:modal-strength partial-affirmative`. A few other calls you may want to check: - **Copula:** I treated 是 as a copula and wrote it as `identity-91`, as the guidelines say for "X is Y", not as PropBank `是-01`. - **Named entities:** HDMI and VGA are both written as `product` named entities. The type and the missing `:wiki` are my guesses. - **Subject of 保留:** the sentence doesn't say what keeps the VGA port. I made it HDMI (`:ARG0 s7p`), but this is the least certain choice in the graph. - **得到满足:** I wrote it as `得到-01` ("obtain") taking `满足-01` ("satisfy") as its `:ARG1`, with the consumers' needs as what is satisfied. PropBank's `满足-01` puts the thing satisfied in `:ARG2`, as in its example "满足……需求". I attached 在不同需求上 there, though the expert may have tied it to the consumers or to 得到. - **Purpose:** the 让 clause is a `:purpose` of 保留. - **Aspect:** 成为 and 保留有 are `state`, describing the current market. 让 and 得到 are `activity`.

# document level relations:
(d / document
    :temporal ((present-reference :depends-on s7x)
               (root :depends-on s7d)
               (s7x :contained s7c)
               (s7d :contained s7i)
               (s7c :overlap s7b)
               (s7b :after s7r)
               (s7r :overlap s7e)
               (s7e :overlap s7m)
               (s7m :overlap s7x2))
    :modal ((root :modal author)
            (author :full-affirmative s7c)
            (author :partial-affirmative s7i)
            (author :full-affirmative s7b)
            (author :full-affirmative s7r)
            (author :full-affirmative s7e)
            (author :full-affirmative s7m)
            (author :full-affirmative s7x2))
    :coref ((s6h :same-entity s7p)
            (s6v :same-entity s7p2)))

These relations come from the guidelines and the given graphs. I did not check any predicate in PropBank.

- **Time expressions:** I treated 现在 ("now") as a vague time and made it depend on `present-reference`. The year 2012 is an absolute date, so it depends on `root`. 同时 ("at the same time") has no relation of its own. Instead I used it to set 保留 ("keep") as overlapping 成为 ("become").
- **Modal strength:** 很有可能 ("very likely") makes the HDMI-as-2012-trend clause `partial-affirmative` from the author. Every other event is a plain `full-affirmative` assertion.
- **Purpose clause:** following the guideline, 让 ("let") is `:after` 保留. The events inside it (得到, 满足, 需求) simply overlap their parent.

Some calls could easily differ from the expert annotation:
- **Coreference:** I linked HDMI and VGA only to their closest earlier mentions in sentence 6. I did not link 消费者 ("consumers") to 用户 ("users") in sentence 3, though they may be the same people. I also left out any `:subset-of` link between the 接口 ("port") nodes, because here they refer to ports in general, not just this monitor's.
- **Purpose events:** I put the 让 clause and its events directly under `author`. The gold may hang them under the `purpose` constant or under 保留 instead.
- **Event under 让:** I made 得到 ("obtain") overlap 让. If the gold reads 让 as causing it, it would be `:after` instead.
